name: Settlement Parties 120
definition: Provides a settlement party by a choice between a BIC or a name and address or a party identification.

DeliveryAgent.name: Delivery Agent
DeliveryAgent.definition: Financial institution from which cash will be transferred.

Intermediary.name: Intermediary
Intermediary.definition: Party, within the settlement chain, between the delivery and receiving agents.

ReceivingAgent.name: Receiving Agent
ReceivingAgent.definition: Financial institution where the payee will receive the funds.

BeneficiaryInstitution.name: Beneficiary Institution
BeneficiaryInstitution.definition: Ultimate institution that will receive the funds when different from the trading or counterparty side.
